ring.desc: A heavy gold band with a regal ruby, a faint aura of command seems to precede the wearer.

ring.desc: A heavy gold band with a regal ruby, a faint aura of command seems to precede the wearer.

ring.name: Silver ruby ring
ring.desc: A common sight adoring the fingers of lesser nobility the silver and deep red a marker of those with a hunger for power.

ring.name: Silver ruby ring
ring.desc: A common sight adoring the fingers of lesser nobility the silver and deep red a marker of those with a hunger for power.

tool.name: Adoring fan statue
tool.desc: A statue of a fan that adores you. It's a bit creepy, while also weirdly flattering. You can hear it saying: "Yes, oh great and mighty Grand Champion? Is there something you need? Can I carry your weapon? Shine your boots? Foot massage, perhaps?"

tool.name: Greedy piggy bank
tool.desc: Each time a coin is dropped in, this golden piggy bank oinks loudly.

tool.name: Omni-tool
tool.desc: This tool, which can be attached to your forearm, is designed to assist with various tasks at your command.

tool.name: Small sack
tool.desc: A small jute sack you can carry with you that can hold an extra item.

tool.name: Adventuring hammer
tool.desc: A hammer with Adventurers' Guild insignia engraved to the base of its handle. You could use it for smithing.

tool.name: Big basket
tool.desc: Beautifully crafted from wicker. Can hold all your foraging finds with ease.

tool.name: Blacksmithing guidebook
tool.desc: The book includes pictures of various forges, hammers, and bellows. The craft of smithing is explained in great detail.

tool.name: Forge bellows
tool.desc: Used to blow air into a forge, to literally pump up the heat.

tool.name: Jarvonian poker
tool.desc: It's not a card game, you can keep your clothes on.

tool.name: Jarvonian smith's hammer
tool.desc: Ice blue hammer with a long handle, so you can put some extra force behind every swing.

tool.name: Spectral hammer
tool.desc: The sturdy bone handle feels light even with the thick ectoplasm head on the end of it, which feels squishy when it isn't being swung around and being used as a smithing tool.

tool.name: Mangrove basket
tool.desc: The mangrove basket was built from two different baskets, but the mangrove planks hide the seams flawlessly.

tool.name: Reinforced bellows
tool.desc: You were tired of your bellows constantly falling into disrepair, but it turns out they just needed some reinforcement!

consumable.name: Nut mix
consumable.desc: Various nuts in a mix that give a good boost of protein with enjoyable flavor all together. Allergies pending.

consumable.name: Beer
consumable.desc: Fermentation may have been a greater discovery than fire.

consumable.name: Saltrum
consumable.desc: Strong distilled alcoholic beverage that makes even the fish drunk.

consumable.name: Spicy pumpkin juice
consumable.desc: This drink calls to the people of Arenum in the autumn.

pet.name: Tortoise
pet.desc: A reserved tortoise, just holding steady. Slowly, but steadily.
pet.rareDesc: The shell of this tortoise has the shine of <c>precious metals in the shape of a flower</c>!

egg.name: Tortoise egg
egg.desc: A tortoise egg. It has an extra hard shell to it. Guess it will never be without one.
